# ImageFlow

ImageFlow 是云原生镜像生命周期与 Workload 镜像更新控制平面：管理镜像流与 tag、追踪镜像变化、按订阅关系更新 Workload 镜像字段，并观测 rollout 与健康状态。它复用 Shipw

`<stream>:<tag>`；status 承载变化历史与投递事件摘要（有界）。语义对齐 OpenShift `image.openshift.io/v1` ImageStreamTag，但非虚拟投影。
_Avoid_: 标签、tag
notes: hybrid lexical+vector body — elected because it looks like natural language (word_ratio 0.79, 574.9 tokens/value); embedded server-side (lexical by default; Candle neural, proxy, or experimental ONNX if configured)
